The overall image looks like a casual, everyday selfie taken by a girl in her bedroom, without any posed or staged feel. The subject's overall demeanor is fresh, natural, genuine, and enduringly attractive, avoiding uniform AI influencer faces, celebrity lookalikes, overly childish features, excessive sweetness, excessive artificial refinement, and highly repetitive template faces. The face shape is petite and delicate but not overly sharp, with naturally balanced facial proportions, preserving subtle real-world asymmetries and individual distinctiveness. Brown eyes, long and naturally slender eyelashes, subtle eyeliner, natural light brown eyebrows, a neat nose tip, soft pink lips, and very light makeup showing a natural no-makeup look. The girl has long, straight, light blonde hair; the hair color is consistently a soft and natural light blonde, neither leaning too white nor too yellow. The hair length falls past the shoulders, resting naturally on both shoulders and across the chest, overall sleek and soft, with the ends having only a very slight, natural curve. On her forehead are light and neat see-through airy bangs, their length naturally covering the forehead without blocking the eyes, accompanied by a few natural wisps of hair framing the sides of her face. A few fine stray hairs and realistic baby hairs are kept at the crown, clearly showing the natural texture and sheen of every single strand of hair. A deep navy-blue three-dimensional floral hair clip is securely worn beside her right ear. Keep the hair color, hair length, straight hairstyle, airy bangs, and deep navy-blue flower hair clip consistent without randomly altering the hairstyle and color. The skin maintains realistic human skin texture, showing fine pores, skin texture, a highlight on the nose tip, subtle cheek color variations, and natural skin tone gradations; the skin is delicate yet retains realistic details, without excessive airbrushing or plastic texture, presenting a high-resolution, genuine photographic quality. The ears are adorned with small silver jewelry: a simple stud earring on one ear and a small silver heart-shaped pendant earring on the other, delicate and understated in style without being overly exaggerated. She is wearing a black lace low-cut camisole top with thin shoulder straps, a naturally low neckline, and delicate lace trim along the chest and edges, fitting close to the body with a slight contouring wrap. The fabric is soft, with natural folds or slight ruffle details across the bust, showcasing an overall feminine and refined style centered on black, lace, low-cut, and camisole elements. The garment fundamentally remains a black lace low-cut camisole, allowing for minor natural fabric variations. The setting is a modern minimalist bedroom, with a warm gray wall in the background, a dark door frame and shadow area visible on the left, and a warm yellow bedside table lamp turned on in the right background; the background is naturally blurred while remaining recognizable as an indoor living space. Mixed illumination of indoor natural light and a warm-toned lamp. The front of the subject receives soft natural light, giving the face gentle and even illumination, with warm yellow lighting from the background on the right and a slightly dimmer area on the left, forming very subtle and authentic chiaroscuro layers. The eyes show natural window light reflections, soft highlights, and no overexposure. Authentic smartphone front-camera selfie style, close-up shot, slight wide-angle perspective, realistic lens distance, just like a casual, natural everyday selfie taken spontaneously by a girl in her bedroom. The image features a shallow depth of field, a naturally blurred background, natural overall colors, soft gradations, preserving real smartphone photography texture and a sense of daily life. Key requirements: securely maintain the core visual elements of long straight light-blonde hair, airy bangs, deep navy-blue flower hair clip, and black lace low-cut camisole; the subject's face should adhere to a natural, delicate aesthetic while strictly avoiding generating highly similar template faces each time; emphasize realism, lifestyle authenticity, and non-templated female beauty, avoiding an overly uniform AI aesthetic. photorealistic, ultra realistic skin texture, visible pores, individual hair strands, natural facial details, realistic smartphone selfie, soft indoor lighting, warm ambient light, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, natural color grading, subtle sensor texture, highly detailed, 4K portrait photography

translations.en: A young adult female taking a close-up smartphone selfie indoors in a bedroom, bust-up close-up composition, face dominating the frame, looking down slightly into the lens, relaxed shoulders, body slightly angled, looking straight at the camera with a calm, natural expression and relaxed lips, feeling like a casual everyday bedroom selfie without posed stiffness. Natural, fresh aesthetic avoiding generic AI influencer looks or celebrity tropes. Subtle asymmetry, brown eyes, delicate eyelashes, natural brows, petite nose, soft pink lips, sheer natural makeup. Straight light blonde hair draped over shoulders, sheer air bangs, delicate flyaways, and a 3D dark navy blue floral hair clip near the right ear. Realistic human skin texture with pores and natural color variation. Silver ear jewelry with a heart charm on one side. Wearing a black lace low-cut camisole. Bedroom background with warm gray wall, door frame on left, glowing warm lamp on the right with shallow depth of field. Photorealistic smartphone selfie aesthetic. photorealistic, ultra realistic skin texture, visible pores, individual hair strands, natural facial details, realistic smartphone selfie, soft indoor lighting, warm ambient light, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, natural color grading, subtle sensor texture, highly detailed, 4K portrait photography
